about: SELF-ASSESSMENT by code reading, local headers and tests, not an external audit or penetration test. OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 IDs; L1 requirements that apply to this site (no user accounts: report access is a bearer link, admin is HTTP Basic) plus L2 items for checkout, webhooks and report tokens. status: pass | fail | unverified (cannot be checked before deployment). Read by scripts/scorecard.ts (S1).

items.evidence: Admin HTTP Basic (src/server/adminAuth.ts) has no failed-login throttling; checkout/quote/leads are rate limited, /api/admin is not.
Report token is in the path by design (/[lang]/report/[token]); mitigated by Referrer-Policy no-referrer, noindex, Cache-Control no-store; host access logs still record it (STATUS AMBER).
orders.ts: reportToken = randomBytes(24) = 192 bits from the CSPRNG.
Every /api/admin route checks adminAuth on the server; reports load only by token lookup.

items.check: No direct object reference to other customers' data
items.evidence: Orders are found by the 192-bit token, never by the order id from the request.
State-changing /api/admin calls require Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin (admin-csrf.test.ts).
Admin is a single Basic credential from the environment; no MFA.
zod schemas on all 8 API route groups; src/server/validate.ts bounds every number (hostile-input.test.ts).
React escapes output; dangerouslySetInnerHTML only for JSON-LD built from internal strings; JSX literals blocked by lint.

items.check: No credentials or payment details in logs
items.evidence: Redacted JSON logs, no PII in logs (STATUS launch readiness GREEN); card data never touches the server (Stripe Checkout).
Report page: Cache-Control private, no-cache, no-store (measured on local build 2026-11-03).
HSTS max-age=63072000 in next.config.ts; production TLS cannot be tested: no domain yet.

items.check: Business flow steps in order, prices server-side
items.evidence: Price set on the server and carried in a signed quote (src/server/payments); INSUFFICIENT_DATA is never sold (payments.test.ts).
Postgres-shared rate limits on checkout, quote and leads (rate-limit.test.ts); they fail open by design.
npm audit --omit=dev 2026-11-03: 0 low/moderate/high/critical.
Next production build; config gate refuses start without production settings (src/server/config.ts).
CSP with script-src/connect-src 'self', frame-ancestors 'none'; 'unsafe-inline' scripts kept on purpose (DECISIONS 2026-11-01) — weaker against injected inline script.
next.config.ts headers.
max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains.
strict-origin-when-cross-origin site-wide, no-referrer on report pages.
CSP frame-ancestors 'none'.
stripe.webhooks.constructEvent with the signing secret; refunded (reversed) order final against replayed 'paid' events (DECISIONS 2026-11-01, payments.test.ts).

items.check: A sold report cannot change after payment
items.evidence: Assessment JSON stored at checkout, never recomputed (stored-snapshot.test.ts).

items.check: Checkout → webhook → email → report against real Stripe test mode
items.evidence: Only mocked in unit tests; needs staging with Stripe test keys (scorecard C1).
